about.page_subtitle: Who is behind DajSrce, why we are building it, and which data we stand on.
about.mission_body_1: Help in Croatia is rarely missing for lack of goodwill. It is missing because people do not know where it is needed, what exactly is needed, or whom to ask. DajSrce exists to remove that gap: a public, free and searchable map of what associations and institutions across the country actually need.
about.mission_body_2: We believe giving should be as legible as any other decision that matters. Every fact we publish names its source, and anything unconfirmed is labelled as unconfirmed.
about.pillar_sources_body: The list of associations comes from the Croatian Register of Associations and is reconciled with the official data. Presence in the register is neither organisational confirmation nor evidence that an association accepts donations: that is a separate, explicit check.
about.pillar_coverage_body: The map covers every active association of a social character, not only those in the large cities. Addresses are matched against the State Geodetic Administration's official address points; where an exact address is unknown we show a coarser location and say so.
about.pillar_evidence_body: We connect you with an organisation and the rest is arranged between you. We do not stand in the middle, and we keep no record of what was handed over.
about.registration_description: As recorded in the Croatian Register of Associations.
about.registration_note: DajSrce is a non-profit association. The details published here can be verified in the public Croatian Register of Associations.
about.team_body: DajSrce is built by students of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing in Zagreb. It started at the Cursor Hackathon Zagreb 2026.

claims.confirm_invalid_next: If the request is still awaiting review, the person who made it can ask DajSrce for a new link. For help, write to {email}.
claims.confirm_closed: The request this link belongs to is no longer open (approved, rejected or withdrawn), so no confirmation is needed.
claims.confirm_unavailable: The confirmation didn't go through just now. Open the link from the email again in a few minutes.
claims.withdraw_failed: The request could not be withdrawn
claims.error_account_ineligible: This account can't claim an association profile.
claims.error_account_linked: This account is already linked to an association.
claims.error_open_claim_exists: You already have a request awaiting review. Withdraw it if you want to choose another association.
claims.error_organisation_claimed: A request for this association has already been sent and is awaiting review. If it wasn't you, write to us at {email}.
claims.error_organisation_linked: Another DajSrce account already manages this association. If that's a mistake, write to us at {email}.
claims.error_organisation_inactive: The association is not active in the official register, so its profile can't be claimed.
claims.error_organisation_not_found: The association is no longer in the published register. Refresh the page and search again.
claims.error_claim_closed: The request has already been decided or withdrawn. Refresh the page.
claims.error_claim_missing: The request no longer exists. Refresh the page.
claims.error_no_registry_email: The register publishes no email for this association, so no confirmation link can be sent. We review the request by hand.
claims.error_invalid: Check what you entered and try again.
claims.error_conflict: That isn't possible in the request's current state. Refresh the page.
claims.error_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
claims.error_network: We couldn't reach DajSrce. Check your connection and try again.

account.title: Account settings
account.subtitle: E-mail notifications and sign-in security.
account.email_body: We also send the notifications you see in the app to {email}: new pledges and signups, changes and cancellations, and decisions on requests. Several notifications close together arrive as one message, and we send no promotional e-mail.
account.email_failed: The setting was not saved. Please try again.
account.unsubscribe_body: We will turn off e-mail notifications for this account. In-app notifications stay, and sign-in and password e-mails still arrive.
account.unsubscribe_done: E-mail notifications are off. You can turn them back on in your account settings.
account.unsubscribe_invalid: This unsubscribe link is not valid or has expired. You can turn off e-mail notifications in your account settings.
account.unsubscribe_error: Unsubscribing did not work just now. Please try again or turn notifications off in your account settings.

admin.title: Administrator dashboard
admin.subtitle: Association profile claims and platform-wide totals.
admin.claims_subtitle: Every request is bound to an entry in the published official register. Approval builds the profile from register data only. The oldest requests come first.
admin.claims_showing: Showing the oldest {shown} of {total} pending requests.
admin.claims_empty_body: When an association claims its profile, the request appears here alongside its register entry.
admin.claims_unavailable: The claim queue is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
admin.claims_registry_missing: Entry is not in the current register snapshot
admin.claims_category_hint: Decides how the association appears on the map. DajSrce is only for associations of a social character: if this one is not, reject the claim.
admin.category_requests_subtitle: Organisations that no category fits type their own. An approved type appears on the public profile, and the category you choose decides the map filters.
admin.category_requests_unavailable: Proposed organisation types are unavailable right now.
admin.category_requests_category_hint: The organisation is found on the map and in lists by this category.
admin.category_requests_note_required: Tell the organisation why the proposal was not approved.
admin.category_requests_error_closed: The proposal has already been decided.
admin.category_requests_error_forbidden: This needs an administrator account with two-step sign-in.
admin.category_requests_error_generic: Please try again in a moment.
admin.claims_category_required: Choose a social category or reject the claim.
admin.claims_note_hint: The note is stored with the claim; on a rejection the applicant sees it.

admin.claims_verification_required: Describe how you checked the applicant.

admin.claims_error_mailbox_not_verified: The register email isn't confirmed. Describe how you checked the applicant (for example by phone with the association's president) and try again.
admin.claims_error_claim_closed: The request has already been decided or withdrawn. Refresh the page.

tour.choose_individual_hint: I want to donate or volunteer

steps.intro_body: DajSrce connects people who want to help with social-welfare associations across Croatia. This short tour shows you how to sign in and everything you can do here. First, tell us who you are.
steps.intro_signed_in_body: You are already signed in, so let's go straight to what you can do on the platform. You can leave the tour at any time.
steps.sign_in_button_title: Signing in is always up here
steps.sign_in_button_body: The "Sign in" button sits in the top right corner of every page; on a phone it is in the menu. Let's see what comes next.
steps.login_form_title: Sign in with e-mail and password
steps.login_form_body: Enter the e-mail address and password you registered with. If you forgot the password, "Forgot your password?" sends you instructions for a new one.
steps.login_google_title: Or in one click with Google
steps.login_google_body: Have a Google account? "Continue with Google" signs you in without another password to remember.
steps.login_sign_up_body: If you don't have an account yet, registration starts here. It takes less than a minute.
steps.register_role_individual_body: Registration starts with the kind of account. As an individual you can pledge donations to associations and sign up for volunteer events.
steps.register_form_individual_body: After "Continue", enter your full name, e-mail address and a password of at least 12 characters, and accept the terms of use. A confirmation link arrives by e-mail and your account is ready.
steps.register_ngo_button_body: Representing an association? The "Register your NGO" button takes you straight to association sign-up. On a phone it is in the menu.
steps.register_role_ngo_body: An association account is linked to its official record in the Register of Associations, so only verified associations can publish.
steps.register_form_ngo_body: This is the address you will sign in with, not necessarily the association's official address. Add your name, a password of at least 12 characters, and accept the terms.
steps.claim_title: Find your association in the register
steps.claim_body: After registering, look up your association in the official Register of Associations, most easily by OIB, or by name or registration number. Select it and briefly describe your role in it.
steps.claim_verify_body: We send a confirmation link to the association's official e-mail address from the register, and an administrator then reviews the request. Until it is approved, the association cannot publish yet.
steps.login_existing_ngo_body: Sign in here, then choose "Link your account to an association" on your profile. You don't need a new account.
steps.map_search_body: Type an association's name, a place or an OIB. Suggestions appear as you type, and picking a place moves the map there.
steps.map_filters_body: Filter by type of association, city and the kind of help an association accepts, such as food, clothing or money. "Only organisations on DajSrce" keeps the ones active on the platform.
steps.map_pins_body: Every marker is an association. Its colour says whether it is only in the register, on DajSrce or verified, and the icon inside shows its type. Click a marker for details.
steps.map_locate_body: "Locate me" shows associations around you, and your location is shared only when you press it. "Choose a city" opens a list of cities.
steps.map_results_body: The associations on the map are also in the list. Pick one to see its address, contacts, opening hours, drop-off hours and everything it accepts.
steps.donate_needs_body: Associations publish their needs here: what they are looking for, how much and how urgently. You can filter by type of association, type of donation and urgency.
steps.donate_pledge_body: On a need, enter a quantity and, if you like, a message to the association. You immediately see whom to contact and where to drop the donation off, and you can withdraw the pledge at any time.
steps.donate_wizard_title: Not sure whom to give to?
steps.donate_wizard_body: "Explore options" guides you in three steps: choose what you want to donate, say where you are, and get the nearest associations that accept it.
steps.volunteer_events_body: Here are the associations' volunteer events: when and where they are, what needs doing and how many places are left. Click an event for all the details.
steps.volunteer_signup_body: Narrow the list to this week or month and join an event with "Sign up as a volunteer". A reminder arrives the day before, and you can cancel at any time.
steps.notifications_body: The bell tells you about important changes, for example when an association edits or cancels an event you joined, or when a reminder is due. The same notifications also arrive by e-mail, which you can turn off.
steps.profile_individual_body: Your profile holds a calendar of your pledges and volunteer sign-ups, your donation history and all your event sign-ups, each of which you can cancel.
steps.ngo_find_title: Your association is already on the map
steps.ngo_find_body: Social-welfare associations from the official register are already on the map. Look yours up by name or OIB and see how people see it.
steps.ngo_profile_body: Once approved, edit the description, contacts, opening hours, drop-off hours and the kinds of help you accept. A complete profile makes it easier for people to help.
steps.ngo_needs_body: Publish what you need: a title, description, type of donation, quantity, urgency and an optional deadline. The need appears right away on the Donate page and on your profile.
steps.ngo_pledges_body: Under "Needs" you see who pledged what, how much of each need is covered and the donors' messages. You can close, reopen, edit or delete a need.
steps.ngo_events_body: Publish an event with a date, time, place, number of volunteers needed and a contact person. When you edit it, the volunteers who signed up are notified.
steps.ngo_volunteers_body: Under "Volunteering" you see, for every event, who signed up and how to reach them, so the details are easy to arrange.
steps.ngo_notifications_body: The bell and e-mail tell you about every new pledge and every new volunteer sign-up, and when someone withdraws.
steps.settings_body: In your account settings you can turn on two-step sign-in with an authenticator app and decide whether you want e-mail notifications. The accessibility menu (larger text, contrast, spacing) is always at hand.
steps.done_body: That's it. Create an account and start helping, or look around the map first. You can reopen this tour from the bottom of any page or from the menu.
steps.done_signed_in_body: That's it. You can reopen this tour from the bottom of any page or from the menu.
